reason: Not paying until I'm happy is the first offer that actually speaks to what happened to me last time, I'll give them that. But they've got no clients, no reviews and they're in Kuwait, so I'm not handing my business over to be their first test case when I've already been through this once.
objection: When something breaks on a Saturday morning, who do I ring? They're thousands of miles away with nobody local, and I've no proof they'll still be answering in six months once they've had their money.
would_change_my_mind: Talking to one or two real UK business owners they've already built for, plus a written monthly support plan with a guaranteed response time when something goes wrong.
